ideal: Alert is warranted: two watchlist stocks with big moves versus the index and no filing in evidence to explain them. Both lines should state stock %, index %, and "no filing explains it yet."

verdicts.note: Both moves covered, all numbers straight from evidence, plain and short, ends each line with the required phrase.
verdicts.answer:
Microsoft rose 4.61% while the S&P 500 rose 0.79% — no filing explains it yet.
Tesla rose 7.62% while the S&P 500 rose 0.79% — no filing explains it yet.
